name: continuous-demo-v2
description: Five-layer continuous DAG with commit triggers, readiness, task-local Fileset transfers and result publication.

command:
set -eu
echo "[prepare] Input: $(cat /tmp/continuous-demo/input/message.txt)"
echo "[prepare] Configuration: $(cat /tmp/continuous-demo/config/settings.txt)"
echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [prepare] Input commit received; preparing 10 simulated partitions"
part=1
while [ "$part" -le 10 ]; do
  echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [prepare] Prepared partition $part/10"
  sleep 1
  part=$((part + 1))
done
echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [prepare] Preparation complete; releasing all 10 workers"
mkdir -p /tmp/continuous-demo/output
{ cat /tmp/continuous-demo/input/message.txt; cat /tmp/continuous-demo/config/settings.txt; } > /tmp/continuous-demo/output/manifest.txt
echo "[prepare] Manifest ready for publication; workers wait for successful upload and commit"

set -eu
echo "[worker-01] Published manifest:"
cat /tmp/continuous-demo/prepared/manifest.txt
echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [worker-01] Starting simulated partition 01; execution=${NEMO_JOB_STEP:-unknown}"
batch=1
while [ "$batch" -le 6 ]; do
  echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [worker-01] Processing simulated batch $batch/6"
  sleep 4
  echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [worker-01] Progress: $((batch * 100 / 6))%; simulated records=$((batch * 100))"
  batch=$((batch + 1))
done
echo "[$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)] [worker-01] SUCCESS; 600 simulated records processed"
